acceptanceCriteria.text: The test deterministically distinguishes the indexed implementation from the pre-#871 repeated-scan behavior.
Repeated CI execution is not sensitive to ordinary scheduler/timing noise at the current tens-of-milliseconds scale.
A deliberate reintroduction of repeated full-fact scans causes the regression test to fail.
Semantic diff correctness tests remain unchanged in authority.

issue.title: test(semantics): replace flaky wall-clock diff scaling gate with deterministic complexity evidence
